@odata.context.description: The information about Karbon controllers generating this response.

WorkScheduleKey.description: A Karbon-generated unique identifier for the Work Schedule

ClientKey.description: A Karbon-generated value used to identify the Client for whom the Work Item is prepared

CreatedFromWorkItemKey.description: The key of the Work Item, which the Work Schedule will be assigned to. This value will be `null`.

RecurrenceFrequency.description: The denominator of time period at which this Work Schedule should repeat. Once set, the value of this property can not be changed.

CustomFrequencyUnits.description:
The unit of time at which this Work Schedule should repeat. Once set, the value of this property can not be changed.

This property is only applicable if `RecurrenceFrequency` is set to `Custom`.

CustomFrequencyMultiple.description: The multiple of time unit at which this Work Schedule should repeat.  This property is not applicable if `RecurrenceFrequency` is set to `SemiMonth`, `Fortnight`, or `Quarter`.

ScheduleStartDate.description: The date at which this Work Schedule should start running

ScheduleEndDate.description:
The date at which this Work Schedule should stop running

To set the Work Schedule to run forever, set the value of this property to `0001-01-01`.

ScheduleDueDateMethod.description: The method that should be used to count the Due Date for the Work Item

ScheduleDueDateDays.description:
The value of the count for the Due Date This property is not applicable if `ScheduleDueDateMethod` is set to `LastDayOfMonth` or `NoDueDate`. Example of usage:
ScheduleDueDateMethod ScheduleDueDateDays Read Due Date as
DaysFromStartDate 7 7 days after start date
DayOfMonth 7 7th day of the current month
LastDayOfMonth N/A Last day of the current month
DayOfNextMonth 7 7th day of the next month
NoDueDate N/A Work has no due date

ScheduleDueDateMonthMultiple.description:
The value to denote the number of the months, if the due date is after 2 months. This property is only applicable if `ScheduleDueDateMethod` is set to `DayOfSubsequentMonth`. Example of usage:
ScheduleDueDateMethod ScheduleDueDateDays ScheduleDueDateMonthMultiple Read Due Date as
DaysFromStartDate 7 3 7th day of the 3rd month after start date

ScheduleDeadlineDateMethod.description:
The method that should be used to count the Deadline Date for the Work Item.

Companies House-driven and filing-date-driven deadline methods are not available through the API; setting `ScheduleDeadlineDateMethod` to `CompaniesHouseAccountsDueDate`, `CompaniesHouseConfirmationStatementDueDate` or `OnFilingDate` returns a `400`.

ScheduleDeadlineDateDays.description:
The value of the count for the Deadline Date This property is not applicable if `ScheduleDeadlineDateMethod` is set to `LastDayOfMonth` or `NoDeadlineDate`. Example of usage:
ScheduleDeadlineDateMethod ScheduleDeadlineDateDays Read Deadline Date as
DaysFromStartDate 7 7 days after start date
DayOfMonth 7 7th day of the current month
LastDayOfMonth N/A Last day of the current month
DayOfNextMonth 7 7th day of the next month
NoDeadlineDate N/A Work has no deadline date

ScheduleDeadlineDateMonthMultiple.description:
The value to denote the number of the months, if the deadline date is after 2 months. This property is only applicable if `ScheduleDeadlineDateMethod` is set to `DayOfSubsequentMonth`. Example of usage:
ScheduleDeadlineDateMethod ScheduleDeadlineDateDays ScheduleDeadlineDateMonthMultiple Read Deadline Date as
DaysFromStartDate 7 3 7th day of the 3rd month after start date

AssigneeUserKey.description: A Karbon-generated unique identifier to indicate the user, whom the Work Item has been assigned to

WorkItemDescription.description: A free form text field for more information about the Work Item

PreventStartEndOnWeekend.description: If the value of this property is set to `true`, the Work Item will not start on Weekends.

InitializeBeforeStartDateUnits.description: You can automatically create a Work Item before its Start date. Use this property to set the unit of delay between Start date and Work Item creation date.

InitializeBeforeStartDateMultiple.description: You can automatically create a Work Item before its Start date. Use this property to set the multiple of delay unit between Start date and Work Item creation date.

WorkItemTitleDefinition.description: Use this property to define the format of the Work Item title. Karbon offers a series of object that you can use to construct Work Item Title. For more information, see Technical Guide to Work Item Title Definition.

WorkItemTitleDisplayText.description: The title of the related Work Item

InitializeTasksBeforeStartDateUnits.description: You can automatically create budget and tasks for a Work Item before its Start date. Use this property to set the unit of delay between Start date and task creation date.

InitializeTasksBeforeStartDateMultiple.description: You can automatically create budget and tasks for a Work Item before its Start date. Use this property to set the multiple of delay unit between Start date and task creation date.
